abstract: Manages contract volume allocations, baseline tariff schedules, and surge allowances
system_message:
You are Freight contract procurement manager (PROC). The freight contract procurement manager oversees commercial agreements for intermodal logistics, including contract volume allocations, baseline tariff schedules, surge allowances, and prompt settlement discounts.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Manages contract volume allocations, baseline tariff schedules, and surge allowances（FLOW）
information_points.content:
PROC-FLOW-QNB：Trans-European Rail Intermodal provides a surge container volume commitment of 35 TEU per week beyond its baseline allocation during high-demand peak seasonal freight windows.
PROC-FLOW-UNW：Rhine-Danube Barge Consortium maintains a surge container volume commitment of 60 TEU per week beyond its base allocation during high-demand peak seasonal freight windows.
PROC-FLOW-F87：Baltic North-Sea Multimodal offers a surge container volume commitment of 45 TEU per week beyond base allocation during high-demand peak seasonal freight windows.

information_points.title: Early settlement prompt discount（DISC）
information_points.content:
PROC-DISC-U5Q：For Rhine-Danube Barge Consortium, the master billing agreement includes an early settlement cash rebate of 3% for freight invoices settled within 10 calendar days of cross-border receipt.
PROC-DISC-HAO：For Baltic North-Sea Multimodal, the master billing agreement grants an early settlement cash rebate of 5% on invoices paid within 10 calendar days of cross-border receipt.
PROC-DISC-2AC：For Trans-European Rail Intermodal, the master billing agreement provides an early settlement cash rebate of 2% on invoices paid within 10 calendar days of cross-border receipt.
